therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Dual immune checkpoint blockade combined with radiation-induced immunogenic cell death
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell activation and anti-tumor immune response enhancement
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Extensive-stage small cell lung cancer patients following standard platinum-based chemotherapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Phase I: Recommended Phase II dose confirmation; Phase II: Progression-free survival at 6 months

results.dose_information: Ipilimumab 3 mg/kg IV every 3 weeks for 4 doses; Nivolumab 1 mg/kg IV every 3 weeks for 4 doses, then 480 mg every 4 weeks; Thoracic RT 3Gy x 10 fractions

context.duration: Treatment duration 13 weeks for combination therapy, follow-up for survival endpoints
